excerpt: Announced March 24, 2025. "RHIC's STAR detector has been operational since RHIC's beginning, with many upgrades culminating in 2022." "For Run 25, the sPHENIX detector, which began operations in 2023, will be using all its capabilities for the first time to study the QGP produced in gold-gold collisions."
title: Relativistic Heavy Ion Collider (RHIC) Enters 25th and Final Run
